name: Reshoot en and zh demos
command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@raspberrypi.tailf63b31.ts.net 'cd ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/asm && S=$(echo ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--google--gemma-3-270m-it-qat-q4_0-unquantized/snapshots/*/model.safetensors) && printf "Hello\n" | timeout 150 ./core $S ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/vocab.bin 2 c ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/bpe.bin 1000 950 48 > /tmp/re_en.log 2>&1; echo EN-EXIT=$?; printf "\xe8\xab\x8b\xe8\xaa\xaa\xe4\xbd\xa0\xe5\xa5\xbd\xe3\x80\x82\n" | timeout 150 ./core $S ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/vocab.bin 2 c ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/bpe.bin 1000 950 48 > /tmp/re_zh.log 2>&1; echo ZH-EXIT=$?; echo "== EN:"; awk "/chat ready/{f=1} f" /tmp/re_en.log | cut -c1-60 | head -8; echo "== ZH:"; awk "/chat ready/{f=1} f" /tmp/re_zh.log | cut -c1-60 | head -8'
